# Segnals MCP Server
> Manage algorithmic trading bots, strategies, and portfolio via AI agents.

## Install

The server is not published to npm. There are two ways to run it, both with `SEGNALS_API_KEY` set in the environment:

- Docker image on GHCR: `docker run --rm -i -e SEGNALS_API_KEY ghcr.io/eidostein/segnals-mcp:latest`
- Build from source: `git clone https://github.com/eidostein/segnals-mcp.git && cd segnals-mcp && npm ci && npm run build`, then `node dist/index.js`

For several accounts, set `SEGNALS_ACCOUNTS_FILE` to a local JSON file of labelled keys (`chmod 600`) instead of `SEGNALS_API_KEY`; every tool then takes `account`. See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.

Before changing any bot setting, read the settings catalog (`segnals_get_settings_catalog`, or the resource `segnals://settings/{engine}`) and use only the paths it lists. A master key, which the account holder creates in Settings → Bot manager, also reads its fleet (`segnals_get_fleet`) and the fleet's report (`segnals_fleet_report`).

- [docs/CHANGELOG.md](docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version history
